requirements.title: Conditional-argument guards are evaluated in order until the selected consequent is known
requirements.definition: For a conditional actual argument, scalar logical expressions are evaluated in order until one is true or the guard list is exhausted; the subsequent consequent of the first true guard is chosen, otherwise the last consequent is chosen.

pending.guard-evaluation-order: PENDING after batch316: gfortran 16 accepts scalar conditional arguments but crashes on side-effecting guard functions needed to portably observe evaluation order; no reference-validated fixture is shipped.

requirements.oracle:
Plans are pending and source-derived. Positive plans establish distinguished non-default state first, then observe portable single-image properties such as exact integer values, exact character values, PRESENT status, defined pointer-association inquiries, rank and bound inquiry results, and caller-side sentinels after procedure return. Unnumbered program restrictions do not create a required processor diagnostic; negative examples for those facets are source-control material only.

S15.5.2.3-001 argument_association_15_5_2_a fixtures: Generated f2023 fixtures establish non-default sentinels, execute the relevant procedure reference, and assert exact integer, logical, character length/text, allocation, bounds, association, PRESENT-independent, or diagnostic-line properties required by the cited source unit. Each runtime facet has a distinct feature mutation that keeps the program conforming and changes the observed association, correspondence, or allocation effect.
requirements.oracle_limitation:
Source accounting only. This packet creates no Fortran fixture, compiler invocation, execution evidence, evidence link, fixture approval, oracle approval, or coverage claim. Diagnostics are not claimed unless a numbered constraint or syntax rule requires them. Undefined association status, undefined definition status, processor-dependent argument-passing mechanisms, storage addresses, descriptor layouts, and coarray/image behavior are not executable oracles here. Future characteristic-boundary plans must treat dummy shape, type, kind, rank, attributes, and intent as characteristics; a non-characteristic illustration must use an entity outside that set.

S15.5.2.3-001 argument_association_15_5_2_a boundaries: Only single-image source-level argument correspondence and defined association/allocation states are asserted. Undefined pointer association status, coindexed/coarray behavior, processor-dependent forwarded TARGET association, storage addresses, descriptor identity, exact diagnostic wording, and unnumbered restrictions without required diagnostics remain pending or out of scope.

Unregistered dependencies retained for future fixtures: later clause 15 optional, pointer, allocatable, procedure, elemental, generic, pure/simple, sequence association, and finalization rules; clause 16 inquiry intrinsics and ISO_FORTRAN_ENV support; clauses 14, 17, 18, and 19 for modules, IEEE support, C interoperability, and association/lifetime state.

requirements.title: The chosen conditional consequent supplies the actual argument or absence
requirements.definition: The chosen consequent-arg supplies its expression or variable as the actual argument, and an expression consequent is evaluated. A chosen .NIL. consequent means the actual argument for that dummy argument is not present.

pending.chosen-expression-evaluated: PENDING after batch316: gfortran 16 segfaults when a function call consequent is used as a conditional actual argument; no reference-validated fixture is shipped.
pending.chosen-nil-actual-absent: PENDING after batch316: gfortran 16 rejects .NIL. conditional consequent syntax, so the F2023 absence rule lacks reference validation on this host.

requirements.title: Each conditional consequent must satisfy non-evaluation-dependent dummy requirements
requirements.definition: Every consequent-arg in a conditional-arg satisfies dummy-argument requirements on declared type, kind type parameters, attributes, and properties that do not depend on evaluating the consequent or contained expressions.

pending.conditional-consequent-type-requirements: Source-control negative uses one integer and one real consequent for an integer dummy; positive control uses two distinct integer consequents and observes selected value 7. No required diagnostic claim.
pending.conditional-consequent-kind-requirements: Source-control negative uses different integer kinds for consequents of a fixed-kind dummy; positive control uses two same-kind integers and observes selected value 13.
pending.conditional-consequent-attribute-require: Source-control negative mixes pointer and nonpointer consequents for a pointer-required context; positive control uses two associated pointer consequents targeting 17 and 19 and observes the selected target value.
pending.conditional-consequent-property-requirem: Source-control negative mixes ranks for a fixed-rank dummy; positive control uses two rank-one arrays with values [2,4] and [6,8] and observes selected array values.

requirements.title: Conditional-argument properties derive from all consequent arguments
requirements.definition: A conditional-arg has the declared type, kind type parameters, and rank of its consequent-args; it has ALLOCATABLE or POINTER only exactly across all consequents; it is polymorphic exactly with at least one polymorphic consequent; its corank is the common consequent corank or zero; and it is simply contiguous exactly across all consequents.

pending.conditional-all-allocatable-or-pointer: PENDING after batch316: gfortran 16 lacks enough conditional-argument support for allocatable or pointer consequent characteristic fixtures on this host.
pending.conditional-polymorphic-any-consequent: PENDING after batch316: not shipped because reference validation of richer conditional consequent characteristics is unavailable on this host.
pending.conditional-corank-common-or-zero: Coarray/corank observation is out of scope by user decision; retain only source-control material preserving the common-corank versus mixed-corank distinction.
pending.conditional-simple-contiguous-all: PENDING after batch316: gfortran 16 rejects array conditional arguments, including sections needed to observe simple contiguity.
